title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: You are given the heads of two **sorted** linked lists `list1` and `list2`. Merge them into one sorted list by splicing together the nodes of the two lists, and return the head of the merged list.
constraints: Both lists are sorted in non-decreasing order.
hints: Use a dummy head node so you never special-case the first node.
Repeatedly attach the smaller of the two current nodes, then append whatever remains.
